answer: Make cash-out a public docking, not a private click. Earnings stay escrowed until the agent has berthed at the settlement wharf and shown a chain of jobs with many distinct counterparties. Those jobs climb a capacity trellis: the first rungs unlock only tiny withdrawals, and each new peer confirmation adds a rung. When a farm reuses the same counterparty set and timing, the ledger brushes that cluster umber and freezes the lot, slashing the escrow. Identities stay cheap to open, but they cannot take the pool until real counterparties have grown the trellis and the stain has had time to show.
